rules.summary: While school is in session, minors under 16 may work outside school hours at most 6 hours a day (8 on non-school days) and 28 hours a week, 7 a.m.-9 p.m. (11 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: Iowa Code § 92.7 (2026) — Under sixteen, hours permitted
citation.excerpt: The hours of work of persons under sixteen years of age employed outside school hours shall not exceed six in one day or twenty-eight in one week while school is in session.

rules.summary: Minors under 16 may work at most 8 hours a day and 40 a week, 7 a.m.-9 p.m. (11 p.m. June 1-Labor Day).

citation.title: Iowa Code § 92.7 (2026) — Under sixteen, hours permitted
citation.excerpt: before the hour of 7:00 a.m. or after 9:00 p.m., except during the period from June 1 through Labor Day when the hours may be extended to 11:00 p.m.
